data.body:
[P2] Support locationless findings in the shared workflow first

For a finding without a changed line, such as a missing design note, this instruction conflicts with the workflow-owned output instructions. The pinned `resolve_ai_review_prompt.sh` appends `ai-pr-review-output.md`, which requires every confirmed finding in `comments`; the schema and publisher require valid diff coordinates for each entry. A summary-only finding therefore violates that contract and bypasses finding IDs, prior-finding tracking, and maintainer-verdict handling. Update the shared output contract and publisher to support locationless findings, then advance the workflow pin here, or require approach findings to reference a relevant changed line.
